subject.title: [Feature]: Thread replies when agent uses tools; top-level for conversational responses

question: Should Slack gain a new default-off tool-use-sensitive reply policy, and what precedence should it have relative to replyToMode, per-channel overrides, DMs, existing threads, and explicit top-level opt-outs?
rationale: Source evidence shows the feature is absent, but adding a new config key and reply-routing heuristic changes a compatibility-sensitive channel behavior that needs maintainer product direction.

options.title: Approve a precise Slack policy
options.body: Define the config shape and precedence rules, then allow a focused Slack plugin implementation with docs and tests.

options.title: Use existing static reply modes
options.body: Treat per-channel replyToMode and account/chat-type replyToMode as the supported solution, leaving tool-use-sensitive threading out of core Slack behavior.

options.title: Defer to broader threading design
options.body: Keep this as design input until maintainers settle a unified multi-channel reply-policy model.

recommendation.title: Approve a precise Slack policy
recommendation.body: Define the config shape and precedence rules, then allow a focused Slack plugin implementation with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on Slack reply-mode behavior and merged the closest partial implementation.
